correctness.rationale: PASS: In stationary common Poisson resetting, the last reset age T~Exp(r) gives conditional variance theta(1-e^{-2muT}), so Q_N/theta=V*(chi2_N/N) with V~Beta(1,b), b=r/(2mu). The exact survival integral over w=1-V with density b*w^(b-1) yields, under w=s/sqrt N and chi-square CLT with exponential Chernoff domination, the edge N^{-b/2} Gaussian-tail integral and threshold gamma constant. For fixed t>1 the gamma survival equivalent exp[-NI(t)]/((t-1)sqrt(pi N)) combined with endpoint rate derivative (t-1)/2 yields 2^b*Gamma(b+1)/(sqrt(pi)(t-1)^(b+1))*N^{-b-1/2} exp[-NI(t)]. Independently numerically evaluated the exact mixture with scipy gammaincc at N=100..1600, b=0.5,1,2 and fixed supercritical t=1.4: ratios approach both stated prefactors. These finite calculations corroborate rather than prove asymptotic uniformity.
